{"thought": "依規則將 UTC 轉台北時間（+8 小時），限定 2025-01-01 至 2025-06-30，App 通路、有效訂單 status IN (1,2,3)，計算商品金額總和（quantity*unit_price_cents/100）除以不重複訂單數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "WITH o AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE channel='app' AND status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0 AS total_twd, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS aov FROM o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id"}}
